Overview

Greenville is a city in SC with a population of 70,720. Falls Park on the Reedy with a stunning downtown revival and Southern hospitality. Housing costs are close to the national average. Gardening thrives here — the 5b growing zone supports Cool — many vegetables, some fruit trees. A large share of residents hold a bachelor’s degree or higher. The population skews young, with a median age of 34.8.
